children: On September 30, 2026, the company notified the NYSE of its completed merger and requested suspension of trading and the filing of Form 25 to delist and deregister its common stock; trading was halted before the market opened that day. Separately, on September 1, 2026, the company filed Form 25 to voluntarily delist its Series H, I, and J preferred stock, which are expected to be removed from trading before the October 5, 2026 market open.
